title: Grateful Dead Live at Ice Palace on 1969-03-29

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a smoking‑hot early‑69 set, highlighted by a fiery Dark Star and high energy throughout
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear sound that showcases the band’s incendiary performance; reviewers rave about the short but intense 1 hr 24 min show, calling it “smoking hot” and noting Jerry’s witty intro to Dark Star. The soundboard source is praised as excellent, making this early ’69 gem highly listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and the audio quality; with limited data confidence is low but the positive indicators justify a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as excellent and crisp; no issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief, high‑octane early‑69 set lasting just over an hour, maintaining a relentless groove and tight transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for his spoken intro to Dark Star and overall fiery playing.
